name: ai-memory
description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
one_liner: A shared notebook that lets different AI coding assistants remember your project and hand work off to each other, so switching between tools doesn't mean re-explaining everything from scratch.
buyer: A development team running more than one AI coding tool (or a solo developer who switches between them) who's tired of re-explaining their codebase every new session.
business_use_cases: A dev team runs one shared memory server so every engineer's AI agent can see decisions and failed approaches other engineers already tried.
A consultant handing a project to another contractor passes the memory server along so the new agent picks up exactly where the last one stopped.
An engineering manager uses the built-in audit log to track what AI agents have actually been doing across the team's repositories.

money_ideas.idea: Host and manage a team's shared memory server as a paid ops service, since most teams won't want to self-host and maintain it themselves.

steal_this: Stand up the self-hosted server for your own two-tool workflow (e.g. Claude Code plus Codex) this weekend and see if cross-agent handoff actually saves you re-explaining time.
